name: @sos-2/execution-fabric
description: SOS 2.0 Execution Fabric (Work Order P5): the provider-neutral orchestration surface composing the Harness Contract (@sos-2/harness) and the Body Broker (@sos-2/body-broker) into bounded task execution — task state persisted through the durable P2 repositories of @sos-2/live-store (the §6 TaskRecord shape, checkpoints, content-addressed artifacts, observation events with replay protection), observations emitted through the typed observation boundary, and AUTHORITY INTEGRATION on every consequential operation: the CURRENT authority grant is resolved to its head revision over the durable AuthorityGrantRepository and re-evaluated through @sos-2/authority's evaluateGrant (the W12 ExecutionAdapter pattern — expired/revoked/missing grants yield typed denials and the operation NEVER runs). A body CANNOT mint or widen authority: the operation surface validates exact request shapes (injected authority keys are typed-rejected), grants resolve ONLY from the durable store, and body outputs enter the observation boundary as NON-AUTHORITATIVE pre-semantic input — a body completion report never certifies a task (§10: completeTask requires the Spirit-side verification record). Task identity is durable: body replacement (kill mid-task -> new body -> resume) preserves the task id and all durable state.
